definitions.explanation: A plump bird with a cooing call, found in both urban areas (pigeons) and symbolic contexts (doves).

examples.english: Feed the pigeons in the park.
examples.notes: 餌をやる/あげる means to feed (animals)

examples.japanese: {鳩|はと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{象徴|しょうちょう}→象徴：05534_shouchou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Doves are considered a symbol of peace.

examples.japanese: {鳩|はと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豆鉄砲|まめでっぽう}→豆鉄砲：28684_mamedeppou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|く}らったような→食らう：10022_kurau⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He has a face like a pigeon hit by a peashooter. (Looking shocked/stunned)

notes:
TYPES:
- ドバト/{土鳩|どばと} (rock dove/feral pigeon) - common in cities
- キジバト/{雉鳩|きじばと} (oriental turtle dove) - wild, shy
- ⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧{鳩|はと} (white dove) - symbol of peace

CULTURAL NOTE:
- ⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{象徴|しょうちょう}→象徴：05534_shouchou⟧ (symbol of peace)
- Associated with shrines and parks
- {鳩|はと}サブレー (dove-shaped cookies from Kamakura)
- Feeding pigeons is discouraged or banned in many Japanese cities due to hygiene concerns.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {鳩|はと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豆鉄砲|まめでっぽう}→豆鉄砲：28684_mamedeppou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|く}った→食う：02657_kuu⟧⟦よう→よう：01114_you⟧ (looking stunned/bewildered)
- {伝書鳩|でんしょばと} (carrier pigeon/homing pigeon)

COUNTING PATTERNS:
- ⟦{一羽|いちわ}→一羽：23976_ichiwa⟧, {二羽|にわ}...

RELATED WORDS:
- クルックー (cooing)
